note: One real Meralco Bill (September 2026), used with the account holder's consent. Every amount, rate, reading and date is transcribed from the printed Bill. Identifiers are placeholders: the holder's name, street address, CAN, Service ID Number, meter number and invoice/reference numbers are not stored. A git-ignored local seed file can map the real CAN for live scans (see server/seed.local.example.json).
